node.title: Prize N=256 square-mass-18 variance/cofactor windows
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, every profile-(4,2,0) collision has autocorrelation variance V=2 mod 8. An exact logarithmic deficit gives cofactor-specific finite windows, and a Lucas-resultant calculation excludes V=2. Cofactor 1538 is impossible; cofactor 1028 retains only V in {10,18}; the other five live cofactors have explicit bounded V=2 mod 8 residuals.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-28: narrows the leading prize S=18 profile without a census or numerical norm estimate. Six cofactor classes remain, so this is evidence for rather than closure of the aggregate pair budget.
